title: Enforcement Actions under Consumer Protection (Fair Trading) Act for Greenwashing
what_it_is: Enforcement Actions under Consumer Protection (Fair Trading) Act for Greenwashing

sections.label: Consumer protection against greenwashing
sections.summary: The CPFTA protects consumers from false or misleading claims including greenwashing, and CASE and CCCS have received no specific greenwashing complaints.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: The Consumer Protection (Fair Trading) Act, or CPFTA, protects consumers against false or misleading claims, including those related to greenwashing.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: The Consumers Association of Singapore (CASE) and the Competition and Consumer Commission of Singapore (CCCS) have not received any specific complaints alleging greenwashing.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: There are existing guidelines under the Singapore Code of Advertising Practice, developed by the Advertising Standards Authority of Singapore, to ensure that advertisers must clearly explain, adequately substantiate and qualify any environmental claim, where necessary.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: The Government will continue to monitor developments on greenwashing and develop further measures, if necessary.

sections.label: Greenwashing complaints and CCCS study
sections.summary: CCCS is studying greenwashing in other jurisdictions, and consumers can approach CASE, which may refer egregious cases to CCCS.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: While the current scope of the CPFTA is sufficiently broad to address greenwashing claims by a supplier in a business-to-consumer (B2C) transaction, CCCS is studying developments on greenwashing in other jurisdictions, in fact, to assess if any specific guidance or regulations would be useful in the Singapore context.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: On the Member's second question, I would like to say that consumers who encounter greenwashing or misleading environmental claims made by suppliers can approach CASE for assistance in resolving the dispute.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: In egregious cases, CASE may refer the supplier to CCCS for investigation.
